brief: Bright Scandinavian-style daylit cafe with a full-height glazed storefront and a wood-framed glass door at the front. A tall window bar with wooden stools runs along the glass. The dining zone in the middle and foreground has round marble-top and square oak tables with woven-seat oak chairs on a light wood plank floor. The long white vertical-panel service counter with a white stone top runs along the back and right, with an espresso machine, two grinders, cake domes and a glass pastry case at the right end. Behind it, oak open shelves hold cups, jars and coffee bags under a large framed blackboard menu. White dome pendants and track spots hang overhead. Potted olive trees, a fiddle-leaf fig, trailing plants and small flower vases soften the white walls. Warm, airy, calm mood.
